reuse.why: The change reuses spreadsheet, budget-writing, batching and undo helpers, but copyPreviousMonth remains outside the shared month-wide category selector.

duplication.why: Category queries are consolidated for most actions, but fixed-group filtering, hidden-category eligibility and the new action's income guard repeat logic elsewhere in actions.ts.

placement.why: Selection and budget calculations stay in the existing budget actions module, with method registration and undo integration in app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, focused tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared selector improves ownership, but maintaining equivalent eligibility rules across it, getBudgetData and individual action guards remains unnecessarily difficult.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth uses getBudgetData and its own hidden-category guard instead of getMonthWideCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts expresses hidden-category eligibility in SQL inside getMonthWideCategories and as a JavaScript guard inside copyPreviousMonth; getBudgetData also repeats the selector's template and fixed-group exclusions.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gains includeHiddenCategories and a conditional SQL fragment, while copyPreviousMonth retains a parallel eligibility path through getBudgetData and a local hidden-category guard.
